title: BUILD-018 Governor — durable programme state (v1)
description: The machine-readable SSOT banked by /rotate-session (T-10) and read by fresh-session reorientation (T-11). Team Knowledge/fusion-brief/session-handoff.md is DERIVED from this document (AD-12) — it is a render, not a rival source of truth. Every collection is required and always present: an absent collection is indistinguishable from an empty one, and 'absent means unknown, never zero' is the map's own missing-field rule (02-MAP.md section 4). A collection that could not be gathered is declared by dotted path in `unknown`.

schema_version.description: Bumped only on a breaking change. A reader that does not recognise the version must say so loudly rather than parse optimistically.

programme.description: Which build this state belongs to. `home` is repo-relative so the document survives being read from a different checkout.

phase.description: CURRENT PHASE — where the programme has got to, in its own vocabulary.

banked.description: Provenance of this banking event. `session_id` is nullable because it is redactable; `head_sha` here is the git HEAD the state was banked AGAINST and is the input to stale detection.

repository.description: BRANCHES/source-control control surface for the programme's own working tree. Booleans and counts are nullable because 'could not determine' must never collapse into `false`/`0`.

tickets.description: COMPLETED WORK and REMAINING FRONTIER in ONE list — deriving both views from a single list keeps the SSOT rule (a ticket cannot be simultaneously listed complete and outstanding). `state: frontier` is machine-checked against `depends_on`.

blockers.description: BLOCKERS that are not dependency edges — open fog, questions only Warwick can settle, external constraints, known live defects. A dependency-blocked ticket is expressed by `tickets[].state = blocked`, not here.

model_recommendation.description: MODEL RECOMMENDATION for the next session — the whole point of the model column in the map's ticket index, made machine-readable so the reorientation brief can state it without re-deriving it.

workers.description: WORKERS dispatched by this programme and their lifecycle. `status: unknown` is first-class — F-7 (reliable live-worker detection) is open fog, and a best-effort detector must be able to say so.

branches.description: BRANCHES the programme touches or must not touch. `role: protected` marks a branch a rotation must leave alone.

pull_requests.description: PRs relevant to the programme, including ones a boundary forbids opening or merging.

worktrees.description: WORKTREES and their disposition. Field names deliberately mirror tools/governor/worktree-recon.mjs (T-07) so its output maps in without translation.

safe_boundary.description: SAFE BOUNDARY — whether the programme is at a point where rotation splits nothing. `at_boundary` is nullable: 'could not establish' is not 'yes'. Obstacles are the precise reasons T-10 would refuse.

resumption.description: EXACT RESUMPTION POINT. `next_action` is the single instruction the fresh session acts on; it is required and non-empty because a state document without it has failed at its only job.

locked_decisions.description: Maps 1:1 to session-handoff.md's 'Locked decisions (durable — do NOT re-litigate)' section — structural compatibility with the existing contract rather than asserted compatibility.

runtime_pointers.description: Maps 1:1 to session-handoff.md's 'Runtime pointers' section. `how_to_read` exists because durable state on a feature branch is invisible from another checkout — the pointer must carry its own retrieval instruction (e.g. a `git show <sha>:<path>`).

privacy.description: PRIVATE-BUILD BOUNDARY (INV-6, GL-012). `private_surface` is MANDATORY even when `none` — the same rule the Work Order gate enforces, for the same reason: a field that may be omitted is a gate that quietly fails to fire. Semantic rules enforced in code, not expressible in JSON Schema: (1) no string anywhere else in this document may contain a `.fusion247` path; (2) a non-`none` surface must be exactly one `private/<project>/**` subtree; (3) a non-`none` surface requires `private_record` — the public document carries a marker, the full record lives privately.

unknown.description: Fields this banking event could NOT determine. An empty collection whose name is NOT listed here is a positive assertion of 'there are none'; a collection listed here means 'we did not look, or could not'. This is the map's missing-field rule (section 4) made machine-readable — and the reason an empty `workers` array can never silently mean 'no workers are running'. `why` is required: a bare 'unknown' with no reason is the kind of unexamined ground this build was commissioned over.
